prompt.why: Two sentences taught the retired split ledger: that revenue, volumes, opex, capex and depreciation stay at field level while royalty, tax and net cash flow are the share, and that government take is measured against a field pre-take value. After EC1-4 every line is the share and take is working-interest invariant.
